# Heading

`content/heading` &middot; content-level &middot; category: content

## Purpose

A heading with a semantic tag (h1-h6) and a separately chosen visual size.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | text |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Section heading (h2 size and tag).
- **display**: Large display heading, for a single statement per email. Sets `level: display`, `tag: h1`.
- **title**: Page title (h1). Sets `level: h1`, `tag: h1`.
- **subheading**: Smaller subheading (h3). Sets `level: h3`, `tag: h3`.
- **centered**: Centered section heading. Sets `align: center`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobileAlignment` | one of `inherit`, `left`, `center`, `right` | `"inherit"` |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `level` | one of `h2`, `display`, `h1`, `h3`, `h4`, `bodyLarge`, `body`, `bodySmall`, `caption`, `eyebrow`, `price`, `salePrice` | `"h2"` |
| `tag` | one of `h2`, `h1`, `h3`, `h4`, `h5`, `h6`, `div` | `"h2"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"left"` |
| `color` | text | `"auto"` |
| `transform` | one of `auto`, `none`, `uppercase`, `capitalize` | `"auto"` |
| `tracking` | text | `"auto"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"0 0 @spacing.sm 0"` |
| `darkMode` | boolean | `true` |

## Responsive behavior

- `mobileAlignment`: `inherit`, `left`, `center`, `right`. Overrides text alignment below 480px (`inherit` keeps the desktop alignment). Best effort, images depend on the client.
- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Heading tags honored with explicit inline styles. | Fine. | Text color swaps via dm-text where honored. Set darkMode off on colored backgrounds. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('content/heading', {
  "text": "Summer Collection"
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "content/heading",
  "data": {
    "text": "Summer Collection"
  }
}
```
